validScenarios.description: Both algorithms agree: 600 seconds per percent off, 120 on; mature coverage and a genuine blend.
Recent usage is weighted twice as strongly as the preceding fortnight. Percentage rates are 400/180 seconds per percent; counter rates are 500/200. Both estimates must contribute.
Six weeks of varying battery-band rates, different screen states and every exclusion reason. Removing excluded raw rows must not change either estimate, weight or learning count.

Off: five percentage drops are insufficient, but three sub-percent counter windows are ready. On: six percentage drops are ready, but two counter windows are insufficient. Each screen state uses the appropriate model alone.
A real version 1 backup. It restores percentage learning, clears previous counter history and uses 100% percentage weight.
One-day-old export with both models at summary ages 55/56 and raw endpoints just before, exactly at and after the rolling seven-day cutoff. Expired raw rows must not erase retained learning.
Sixty-day-old backup: both histories expire completely. Both modes show Learning above the target and zero at/below 15%, including after replacing mature data.
Off: variable percentage history gives the stable counter model more influence. On: stable percentage history outweighs variable counter history. Neither ready model is switched off.
